blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — It’s still premature to say that there is already a number enough to convict or acquit Vice President Sara Duterte as her impeachment trial remains ongoing, according to Sen. Risa Hontiveros. “I think premature for me or for anyone to say that there is already a number for conviction or number for acquittal because we have only heard one side,” she said in an interview on radio dzBB on Sunday. The Vice President’s defense team will begin presenting its evidence before the Senate impeachment court on Monday, with dozens of witnesses lined up for the first week to […]...
